gradeScale: Letter tiers S+ (best) down through S, S-, A+, A ... with an optional separate tier for the IEM after his listed mod/EQ.

entries.name: DUNU EST 112
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S+ and describes its signature as "Bass-boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Handles my entire library like Ultra Instinct Goku handled Jiren.

entries.name: Shuoer EJ07M
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S+ and describes its signature as "L-shaped".
entries.quote: Great complement to the EST112, Very impressive bass texture, forward vocals and non-fatiguing treble, exeptional soundstage depth & imaging

entries.name: HIDIZS MP145
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S+ and describes its signature as "L-shaped".
entries.quote: DD-like (tonality & timbre) Planar (technicalities and driver) tuned almost 1:1 to what I would personally do if I had a Planar collab, then this is it. (HIDIZS STEALTH REVISED THIS)

entries.name: Sony XBA-N3
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S and describes its signature as "Bass-boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Phenomenal tonality balance, spectacular bass quantity/quality, high quality mids and non-fatiguing and yet natural treble, coherency/timbre masterpiece

entries.name: Fiio FD5
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S and describes its signature as "U-shape".
entries.quote: Awesome soundstage, clean but fun bass and airy treble

entries.name: DUNU Zen
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Best bass I have heard. Lower-treble can be a bit too much for some (not for me), upper-treble is rolled-off too much

entries.name: Sony MDR-EX1000
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B (S when modded with EQ) and describes its signature as "Bass-boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Highly technical single DD legend, huge soundstage and very versatile (needs EQ)

entries.name: Tin HiFi P1 Plus
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ (S when modded) and describes its signature as "L-shape".
entries.quote: Best planar iem out there, excellent timbre, great bass, great vocals, non-fatiguing treble & airy (PEQ)

entries.name: LZ A7
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S- (S when modded with Pop-black+High-density tuning foams) and describes its signature as "Bass boosted-neutral".
entries.quote: Versatility GOD, can play my entire library and sounds very natural with good technicalities (POP-RED) / (modded notes: bass tighter/faster, more texture, cleaner vocals, airirer treble and bigger soundstage

entries.name: Sony MDR-EX800ST
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- (S when modded with EQ/Filterlesss/BluTack) and describes its signature as "Bass boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Extremely wide soundstage, natural sound and fun (EQ), NEARLY IDENTICAL TO THE EX1000 AFTER REMOVING THE FOAM (MY ENDGAME!)

entries.name: CCA CRA
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S- (S when modded with 500 mesh + Sony General Foam) and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: Phenomenal Upper-treble and sub-bass, vocal tonality, Airy, clean and energetic treble, very good technicalities (modded) (KZ STEALTH REVISED THIS!!!)

entries.name: Sony XBA-A3
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S and describes its signature as "Bass-boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Take the XBA-N3 + EX800ST and you have the A3, great tonal balance with excellent timbre/coherency along with a clean bass.

entries.name: GS Audio GD3A
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S- and describes its signature as "Mild V-shape".
entries.quote: Budget king, highly technical, well tuned and rivaling Sony in timbre/coherency.

entries.name: LZ A6
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S- and describes its signature as "V-shape".
entries.quote: Treble Endgame, very "unique" sounding, HARD TO RECOMMEND DUE TO MOISTURE ISSUES

entries.name: Tanchjim Oxygen
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S- and describes its signature as "Bright-neutral".
entries.quote: Excellent iem for acoustic/vocal music

entries.name: TRI i3 Pro
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it S- and describes its signature as "U-shaped".
entries.quote: Basshead quantity but with great quality, great vocal quality and airy/smooth treble, huge soundstage, might lack some 4-6k for treble-heads though

entries.name: KZ DQ6
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- (S- when modded with High-Density Tuning Foam) and describes its signature as "V-shape".
entries.quote: bass thats clean because of the quality and fun because of the quantity, mids are natural in timbre/tonality but recessed (male vocals), airy and detailed treble, huge soundstage

entries.name: SoftEars Volume
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C (S- when modded with 3mm Y2 paper filter on BA bore) and describes its signature as "Bright-neutral".
entries.quote: Great bass texture/rumble/tightness, female vocals and treble smoothness and air, excellent timbre and coherency and stage depth (MODDED)

entries.name: FiiO FH3
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "L-shape".
entries.quote: Spectacular bass performance, good mids (quality, quantity and balancing), Non-fatiguing treble, but has BA timbre in the mids/treble

entries.name: Sony XBA-Z5
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: 2.1 speaker setup in an iem form, very musical with a huge soundstage.

entries.name: Ikko OH10
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "Warm V-shaped".
entries.quote: Basshead levels of sub-bass but still quite clean, very coherent and great timbre overall.

entries.name: Tanchjim Hana
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B (A+ when modded with Foam mod) and describes its signature as "Reverse L-shape".
entries.quote: Good SQ bottlenecked by its horrible peaks (upper-mids/lower-treble) (EQ)

entries.name: Intime Sora 2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A (A+ when modded with EQ) and describes its signature as "Reverse L-shape".
entries.quote: Unique sounding, good technicalities and very good tonality, boring due to low bass quantity for me though

entries.name: DUNU Falcon Pro (Reference filter)
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "Warm V-shape".
entries.quote: Rock/metal champion, not very technical though

entries.name: Kiwi Ears Orchestra Lite
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: DD-tier bass, smooth treble, excellent timbre/coherency. Default BA rec

entries.name: Simgot EA500
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Balanced sounding, excellent mid-bass texture, and very good tonality for vocals and OST tracks, excellent timbre

entries.name: Simgot EM6L
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "U-shape".
entries.quote: Very well tuned U-shaped set, has treble energy but is still ultra smooth

entries.name: Kiwi Ears Forteza
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C+ (A+ when modded with 4x2.5mm low density foam in BA bore) and describes its signature as "L-shaped".
entries.quote: Default recommendation for a dark/smooth treble alongside a very powerful but textured bass that is tight/fast. Does have quite the recessed mids though. (modded)

entries.name: Simgot EA500LM
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "U-shape".
entries.quote: true upgrade from the EW200 with fantastic timbre and is a fun U-shaped iem

entries.name: Simgot Audio EW300
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A+ and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Balanced set with warmth and smoothness with excellent piezo implementation

entries.name: Urbanfun YBF-ISS014
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A and describes its signature as "Bright U-shape".
entries.quote: Performs on a very high level sonically but Urbanfun is blacklisted for me and I will not recommend anything from them because of how they handled the ISS014....

entries.name: Shuoer Tape
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C+ (A when modded with EQ) and describes its signature as "Warm V-shape, very "Unique" sounding".
entries.quote: Sibilant around 3,5kHZ, but my EQ preset fixes it and makes it very good (still recessed vocals) ranked B- without EQ

entries.name: TinHiFi P1
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- (A when modded with EQ) and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: High Gain, EQ (Preamp: -7 DB Low-shelfs: 80 HZ, Q:0.64, DB:2, ; 150 HZ, Q: 1.1, DB:4,5), Good with Tubes, POWER HUNGRY STOCK RANKING B+ (Bright neutral signature)

entries.name: Blon BL03
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ (A when modded with Mesh mod) and describes its signature as "warmish L-shape".
entries.quote: modded

entries.name: TForce Audio Yuan Li
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A and describes its signature as "Neutral".
entries.quote: Well tuned, neutral iem with excellent imaging capabilities (the iem version of the K´s LBBS earbud)

entries.name: Audiosense DT600
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B (A when modded with 30 ohm adapter + Tanchjim filters) and describes its signature as "Bass-boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Super clean bass but has elevated sub-bass (Monarch-like tuning) with very impressive texture. Great vocals and energetic treble. Lacking in soundstage depth though

entries.name: Intime Sora Light 2019
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A and describes its signature as "L-shaped".
entries.quote: One of the best budget iems, great tonality, impressive bass quantity/quality, airy but non-fatiguing treble and good mids, impressive soundstage, good timbre and coherency

entries.name: KZ BA10
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C+ (A when modded with Tanchjim Filter + PEQ) and describes its signature as "Mild V-shaped".
entries.quote: Great bass for a BA set, Vocal tonality, smooth treble & non-fatiguing, Great timbre, Soundstage (depth), VENTED SHELL

entries.name: DUNU Titan S
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A and describes its signature as "Bright-neutral".
entries.quote: Clean/smooth/airy treble, Excellent vocal tonality (female), very clean bass, technical and excellent timbre

entries.name: KZ DQ6S
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A and describes its signature as "L-shaped".
entries.quote: Great for rock/metal, non-fatiguing/smooth treble, lots of bass and great mid-bass texture, good timbre

entries.name: KZ EDX Ultra
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: Best non-modded KZ, well tuned bass, treble is mostly smooth and very airy, pretty good stage and very good timbre (for a KZ)

entries.name: ThieAudio Hype 2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A and describes its signature as "Bass boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Clean tight bass pretty good textured, Good balance with male/female vocals, smooth treble, good timbre. Very small stage however

entries.name: Simgot Audio EA1000 (red nozzle)
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ (A when modded) and describes its signature as "Bass boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Not good stock and the PR is pure marketing, with mods pretty decent iem with good bass texture, smoothness and warmth. But even still, it does not surpass the EA500

entries.name: Simgot EW200
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A and describes its signature as "U-shape".
entries.quote: Great starter iem for newbies due to high value

entries.name: DUNU Titan X
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- (A when modded) and describes its signature as "n-shaped".
entries.quote: rolled sub and treble, very forward vocals both male and female

entries.name: Moondrop KATO
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- (A- when modded with Sony Import Foam) and describes its signature as "Neutral".
entries.quote: Well tuned neutral iem, clean bass, clean and non-fatiguing treble, good mids, excellent timbre (stock), Modded is similar to the Sony XBA-Z5 but more neutral (and less technical)

entries.name: Audiosense DT200
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- and describes its signature as "Bass boosted-Neutral".
entries.quote: limited technicalities by only having 2 BAs, very good tuning, relaxed and still fun

entries.name: Shozy Form 1.1
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- and describes its signature as "warm L-shape".
entries.quote: relaxed treble, textured, tight and quite fast bass with even male/female vocals that is just a tiny bit behind the rest

entries.name: BQEYZ Spring 2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- and describes its signature as "Bright Reverse L-shape".
entries.quote: Natural sounding and well implemented piezo driver, that sounds like a BA, need some more bass quantity/texture

entries.name: Vento Conductor T-500 Pro
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B (A- when modded with High-density Tuning Foams + Tanchjim Tanya filters) and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: A lot of bass quantity & good quality, but recessed mids (occasionally veiled), laidback treble with some air, slightly below technicalities (for the price) and narrow soundstage

entries.name: Tanchjim Tanya
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- and describes its signature as "Warm V-shaped".
entries.quote: Mid-bass version of the Sony MH750 with much better soundstage that is holographic. Included tips/filters are great accessories

entries.name: KZ ZEX Pro
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D+ (A- when modded with PEQ) and describes its signature as "U-shaped".
entries.quote: good tuning with huge bottleneck in a 8k peak. Timbre is unnatural as well. (fixed with PEQ)

entries.name: DUNU Vulkan
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Good bass texture, imaging, stage width and timbre, but nothing else is special about it

entries.name: CCA CRA
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: Very airy treble but too much for me as well, more mid-bass focused than sub-bass compared to the original CRA and with less mids.

entries.name: BLON x HBB Z300
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: Better than stock BL-03 but worse than the modded BL-03. Great for hip-hop, R&B and Rock/metal. Not for classical, OSTs, Jrock/pop

entries.name: Tanchjim One DSP
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B (A- when modded with Tanchjim App Custom PEQ) and describes its signature as "Bass boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Clean sounding, fast/tight bass, good imaging, nothing really wrong but nothing stands out

entries.name: AFUL Performer 5+2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it A- and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Very safe, inoffensive and good rec for beginners but does not do anything special to stand out

entries.name: Audiosense DT100
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Warm bass-boosted-neutral".
entries.quote: Best BA bass and timbre I have heard. But lacking in resolution and technicaltiies.

entries.name: Final Audio E5000
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Warm, Dark, L-shape".
entries.quote: Bloated bass, dark treble and lacking in technicalities/resolution. (QC IS GARBAGE!)

entries.name: Final Audio E3000
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: Bloated bass but otherwise well tuned and a non-fatiguing iem (QC IS GARBAGE!)

entries.name: iBasso IT00
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: bass lacking in quality, but tuned to be relaxing and non-fatiguing

entries.name: Moondrop Blessing 2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "VDSF-target".
entries.quote: Extremely clean sound and technicalities are very impressive

entries.name: Sony XBA-A2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: An iem that is going after my heart by sounding really natural, fun and still relaxing with my library

entries.name: Audiosense T800
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ (A+ when modded with Foam mod) and describes its signature as "Bright U-shape".
entries.quote: EQ, colored sound but very fun

entries.name: BLON BL-05
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Bright soft V-shape".
entries.quote: Clean sound but can be sharp at times with female vocals and some instruments (like electric guitars)

entries.name: Tingker TK200
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: BASSHEAD, massive bass and on the loose side but very clean, non fatiguing treble

entries.name: Sony MH750
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "U-shape".
entries.quote: Ridiculous SQ at this price, the naturality of the MH750 is beyond anything at this price ( Rank B without EQ to tame the 3,5k and 7k peaks)

entries.name: Intime Yo
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "L-shape".
entries.quote: Very bassy (and loose) sound but good mids and treble that are not offending

entries.name: Final Audio E1000
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C (B+ when modded with Micropore mod) and describes its signature as "Bass boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Better sounding E3000 and also cheaper, (micropore tape mod) stock version rank = C (QC IS GARBAGE!)

entries.name: SeeAudio Bravery
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Mildly V-shaped".
entries.quote: Well tuned, good technicalities and good timbre, but too expensive to recommend and doesnt suit my library anyway

entries.name: Sony WF-1000XM3
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Warm-neutral".
entries.quote: Very well balanced tonality, on the warmer side and does have treble air and bass elevation along with quality. Soundstage is pretty good and very good timbre. More balanced version of the XBA-N3

entries.name: Kiwi Ears Quintet
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Bright U-shaped".
entries.quote: tuned decently well, that is not really anything special in the iem world nowadays and I honestly do not find it to be anything special and even their own lineup beats it

entries.name: DUNU Titan S2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B+ and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Titan S + Simgot house tuning + downgrade = S2, quite generic sounding

entries.name: Aiderlot M5 (no filter)
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "DF-neutral".
entries.quote: Well tuned BA iem with very good timbre and essentially a budget Oxygen with the same performance except for the bass.

entries.name: BLON BL-01
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: Very good tuning that is heavily bottlenecked by the poor technicalities

entries.name: Moondrop KXXS
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "Bright neutral".
entries.quote: made "obsolete" by Moondrop themselves because of the Starfield (probably)

entries.name: ISN D10
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "U-shape".
entries.quote: Unique "Sub-woofer" like sub-bass

entries.name: LZ A6 Mini
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "Bright small U-shape".
entries.quote: Extremely good sound quality in this price range (70 usd ish), but has a very recessed male vocals

entries.name: Fiio FH5s
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "U-shaped".
entries.quote: Jack of all trades master of none, BA timbre in the treble and incoherent for the price it is at. Doesnt really stand out with anything.

entries.name: Tansio Mirai TSMR-4 Pro (on-on-off)
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- (B when modded with Foam mod) and describes its signature as "Bright-neutral".
entries.quote: Does not compete in the price range it is at. Good vocals and technicalities, but has unnatural BA timbre across the range

entries.name: KBEAR Neon
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "DF-neutral".
entries.quote: Well tuned single BA with decent timbre for a BA iem and uncolored sound. Can be boring though due to the very low bass quantity, but good for neutral-heads

entries.name: GS Audio GD11
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D+ (B when modded with EQ) and describes its signature as "Treble-rolled-neutral".
entries.quote: The tonality is messing up the entire iem, otherwise there is some potential (as can be heard with EQ)

entries.name: Audiosense DT300
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D (B when modded) and describes its signature as "Warm-neutral (EQ)".
entries.quote: Inferior to the DT100/200

entries.name: 7Hz Timeless
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "U-shaped".
entries.quote: Good tonality, heavily bottlenecked by almost zero stage depth and horrible imaging

entries.name: GS Audio ST1
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "Bright-neutral".
entries.quote: Excellent female vocals, decent bass, meh for everything else. (specialist tuning)

entries.name: Sennheiser CX 400BT
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "Warm L-shaped".
entries.quote: Bassy on the slower/looser side but pretty clean, mids are a bit recessed, somewhat dark treble but does have air. Impressive imaging and with good timbre

entries.name: Tanchjim Echo
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "Bright U-shape".
entries.quote: Very technical, clean, weeb tuning

entries.name: KZ EDX Pro
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "Warm V-shaped".
entries.quote: Bassy beater set, lacking in technicalities but has pretty good soundstage and timbre

entries.name: KZ ZES
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: Warmer than the CRA with less air, just get the CRA instead

entries.name: 7Hz Legato
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "Warm V-shape".
entries.quote: HUGE amount of bass quantity, recessed mids, mostly smooth treble but a peak at 6.5k hurts. Below average technicalities for price

entries.name: CVJ Konoka (on-on)
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C+ (B when modded with 4x3mm foam+ cotton BA nozzle+500 mesh) and describes its signature as "Mild V-shape".
entries.quote: Fast attack/decay, lacks bass texture, slightly recessed upper-mids, airy treble, poor stage size, unnatural timbre, good coherency

entries.name: Tangzu FUDU Verse 1
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B and describes its signature as "L-shaped".
entries.quote: Inferior version of the Shozy Form 1.1

entries.name: AZLA Azel
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- and describes its signature as "V-shape".
entries.quote: A lot of bass, but recessed mids and harsh treble

entries.name: Final Audio E4000
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- and describes its signature as "warmish soft-V-shape".
entries.quote: Not worth the price but doesnt sound bad, just that there are better stuff out there (QC IS GARBAGE!)

entries.name: Final Audio E2000
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- and describes its signature as "Bass-boosted neutral".
entries.quote: Average sound quality but good tonality and good value due to the Type E Tips (QC IS GARBAGE!)

entries.name: Hisenior T2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- and describes its signature as "Midcentric".
entries.quote: High ranked only because there doesnt seem to be much competition for this sound profile in this price range

entries.name: Tin HiFi T3 Plus
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C+ (B- when modded with 2 High-density tuning foam + tanchjim filter) and describes its signature as "Mildly V-shaped".
entries.quote: Relatively balanced tuning, lacking in technicalites and extension though

entries.name: Juzear Butterfly 61T
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it B- and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Jack of all trades master of none with bad timbre

entries.name: ThieAudio Voyager 3 (on-off)
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C+ and describes its signature as "U-shape".
entries.quote: stock configuration, with 4 different switch configurations, hisses a lot

entries.name: LZ A4 Pro
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C+ and describes its signature as "Dark V-shaped".
entries.quote: Very laid-back tuning with a sub-bass focus, but lacking in technicalities.

entries.name: Aiderlot M5 Pro
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C (C+ when modded with 3mm WTF 500 grade on one bore) and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: Tight and fast bass that does not have that much texture, wonky & recessed mids, bright tonality yet lacking a lot of air. Timbre is off. Decent stage depth. Akin to LZ tuning but worse

entries.name: Sony MDR-XB75AP
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C and describes its signature as "Warm V-shape".
entries.quote: A lot of bass quantity but tight. Mids are natural but a bit behind the bass/treble. treble is natural but a bit sharp. (EQ)

entries.name: Dunu DM-480
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C and describes its signature as "U-shape".
entries.quote: Strong Sub-bass, more linear Mid-bass, poor timbre

entries.name: LZ Z05A
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Bass, mids and technicalities are very good but the treble and overall sound is unrefined

entries.name: JVC FW02
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Natural bass and male vocals, but very grainy and sharp treble along with sharp female vocals

entries.name: Final Audio EVA2020
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C and describes its signature as "Warm-neutral".
entries.quote: Non-fatiguing and relaxing set without any offending factors (QC IS GARBAGE!)

entries.name: Audiosense T180 Pro
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C and describes its signature as "n-shaped".
entries.quote: Well tuned single BA with good timbre for a BA set. Poor technicalities and resolution are the bottlenecks along with the roll-offs at both ends

entries.name: Final Audio VR3000
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: Lacking bass texture and low quantity, recessed mids, treble is peaky (8k is real) and fatiguing, meh technicalities and timbre (QC IS GARBAGE!)

entries.name: Tin HiFi T3
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C- and describes its signature as "Bright neutral".
entries.quote: A bit too much brightness making it sound a bit too thin

entries.name: CCA C10
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C- and describes its signature as "V-shape".
entries.quote: Good treble without peaks, bass punch, slightly recessed mids. Timbre not that good

entries.name: LZ Z04A
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C- and describes its signature as "Bright V-shape".
entries.quote: Sibilant treble and a bit recessed mids but Bass and the technicalities are very impressive

entries.name: KBEAR KS2
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C- and describes its signature as "Warm V-shape".
entries.quote: High bass rumble and big soundstage, nothing else note worthy (very recessed mids)

entries.name: KZ ZS7
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C- and describes its signature as "V-shape".
entries.quote: Bass rumble and quantity, little bass bleed into the mids, kinda peaky treble

entries.name: CCA NRA
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it C- and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Lacking technicalites, relatively non-offensive tuning but doesnt do anything great

entries.name: Kinera Freya
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D+ and describes its signature as "Bright U-shape".
entries.quote: its like if someone took a machine gun and filled it with needles then shot them all into my ears...

entries.name: KBEAR Robin
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D+ and describes its signature as "Warm L-shape".
entries.quote: A very bassy, on the slower/looser side with a very relaxing/non-peaky treble. It will suit people that want an even bassier/warmer sounding Blon 03. Timbre is pretty decent for a hybrid.

entries.name: Moondrop Quarks
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D+ and describes its signature as "Bright-neutral".
entries.quote: Decently tuned bright-neutral iem, that is a little bit shouty and lacking technicalities

entries.name: GS Audio GT12X
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D+ and describes its signature as "Dark L-shape".
entries.quote: Dark treble, too warm bass lacking texture, mids are butchered, lacking tech and has some BA timbre

entries.name: Periodic Audio Be
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D and describes its signature as "Bright U-shape".
entries.quote: Harsh, grainy, sharp vocals and treble. The bass is the saving grace for this. They turned gold into shit, if it really is a pure BE DD driver.

entries.name: KZ ZS4
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D and describes its signature as "V-shape".
entries.quote: powerful bass and good control, recessed mids, non-peaky treble

entries.name: Moondrop Spaceship
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D and describes its signature as "Bright neutral".
entries.quote: Moondrop does really good stuff, but not this one

entries.name: Geek Wold GK10
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D and describes its signature as "Warm V-shaped".
entries.quote: Bloated bass, recessed mids, treble lacking air, unnatural timbre, very incoherent, zero QC

entries.name: FIIL T1 Lite TWS (bass EQ)
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: lots of bass that is muddy, recessed mids, warm and yet sharp treble. Poor technicalities and unnatural timbre

entries.name: CCA CA10
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: Bloated bass, recessed mids, harsh and sharp treble, unnatural timbre, butchered technicalities, why the fuck does this exist

entries.name: Lypertek PurePlay Z3 1.0
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D and describes its signature as "Bass-boosted DF neutral".
entries.quote: very shouty, has the timbre that you expect from old KZs, bass shelf clean but there is a big lack of texture, extension and rumble. Technicalities are worse than all the wired sets you can find for around 10-20 usd

entries.name: KZ ED9 (balanced filter)
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D- and describes its signature as "Warm V-shape".
entries.quote: lots of mid-bass quantity although too boomy, good female/male vocal balancing, very slight treble sharpness (balanced filters)

entries.name: KZ EDR1
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D- and describes its signature as "Bright V-shape".
entries.quote: Typical chi-fi tuning, some sibilance, good bass control, Typical KZ sound

entries.name: EarSonics Onyx
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it D- and describes its signature as "Warm V-shaped".
entries.quote: Bloated bass, recessed mids, peaky treble, unnatural timbre, poor coherency...

entries.name: KZ ZSE
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it E+ and describes its signature as "Dark V-shape".
entries.quote: non-peaky treble, Powerful bass

entries.name: Bamboo Forest Bird Jinghong
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it F (E+ when modded with Sony Import foams + PEQ) and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: giga bloated bass, no mids, banshee treble without any air. Metallic timbre across the range.

entries.name: Final Audio E500
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it E and describes its signature as "Neutral".
entries.quote: MASSIVE CHANNEL IMBALANCE

entries.name: Shuoer Tape Pro
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it E and describes its signature as "Balanced".
entries.quote: Worse than the previous tape in every single way possible, should be renamed as the Torture Pro

entries.name: Venture Electronics Bonus IE
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it E- and describes its signature as "Very dark".
entries.quote: Good build quality, but very bloated and bleeding bass

entries.name: Co-Donguri Brass Balanced
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it E- and describes its signature as "Bright V-shape".
entries.quote: Low bass quantity, recessed mids, treble like a dying banshee. Brass = heavy metal? more like heavy trash

entries.name: JVC HA-FX6
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it E- and describes its signature as "V-shaped".
entries.quote: Super bloated bass, dark hole mids, harsh and sharp treble, no tech, poor timbre.

entries.name: Final Audio F3100
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it F and describes its signature as "Bright-analytical-reverse-L-shape".
entries.quote: Incapable of reproducing bass, unnatural timbre, some sharp treble, sharp female vocals and thin male vocals (QC IS GARBAGE!)

entries.name: Tripowin TP10
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it F and describes its signature as "Bright".
entries.quote: Screeching unnatural garbage

entries.name: Geek Wold GK3
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it F and describes its signature as "Warm V-shape".
entries.quote: This is muddier sounding than REAL MUD, I rather eat mud than listen to this garbage

entries.name: VJJB N1
entries.verdict: Rikudou Goku ranks it F and describes its signature as "L-shaped".
entries.quote: Sharp treble, recessed mids, unnatural sound = Garbage
